structured_output.what_is_happening: This is one of at least 10 "Effective Accelerationism" (e/acc) tokens launched within about 30 minutes of each other. The spark appears to be an X post by @beffjezos (Guillaume Verdon, the e/acc founder). The token description says fees go to @beffjezos via UsePaid, a service that sends pump.fun token fees to X accounts. This contract (J2b37...) was created about 18 minutes after the leading clone, CbcyNo... (about $313k market cap, $2.1M hourly volume). It sits at about $22k market cap on a PumpSwap pair created directly, not migrated from the pump.fun curve. Its liquidity is 100% unlocked and the creator has closed their position. It is riding spillover from the ticker frenzy.

narrative.description: The e/acc / Beff Jezos meme, apparently set off by a Beff post and by UsePaid fee routing to his X handle. The figure is well known in crypto and AI circles.
narrative.why_spreading: A famous account appears linked through fee routing, and a meme-hungry market spawned a burst of same-name launches.

token_connection.why_this_token: Nothing distinguishes it except the same name, the same description and fees routed to @beffjezos. Any of the clones can claim that.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo... is the earliest and largest ($313k market cap, $2.1M hourly volume). Also EnmeFDQ5 ($923k hourly volume), EsVbL6 ($706k), 6TrwU9, 9VKRBm, DseCuJ and others, plus an older GqmEdR...pump from 2024.

authenticity.evidence: 893 unique buyers against 118 unique sellers looks broad, but GMGN tags 904 of 912 holders as fresh wallets and 42 as bundlers (bundlers hold 12% of the top traders' share). The volume likely comes from sniper and bot rotation across the clones.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the X post (HTTP 402) and could not confirm whether Beff endorsed any particular contract.

structural_risks: LP is 100% unlocked on a PumpSwap pair created directly, so the pool can be pulled
A crowd of stronger same-name competitors is draining attention
Almost all holders are fresh wallets, with bundlers present

structured_output.counterargument: Market cap is only $22k with $33k of liquidity, and turnover is very high: about 900 buyers in 12 minutes. If rotation traders pick this clone as the "cheap e/acc", or if Beff or UsePaid points to it, a 2x to about $45k is trivial compared with the leader at $313k.
unknowns: What Beff's post actually says and which contract, if any, it names
Whether the LP owner will pull liquidity
Whether UsePaid fee routing is real for this contract

source_coverage.notes: Time-limited. One web search confirmed that Beff Jezos and UsePaid exist. The X status fetch returned 402.

structured_output.thesis: A late, non-canonical clone in a same-ticker swarm, with an unlocked LP and a closed-out creator. The low market cap gives some chance of a 2x on spillover, but the most likely outcomes are fading or being pulled.
